stories.title: Define Allowlist Configuration Source and Loader
stories.description: Implement a centralized allowlist configuration (collections, fields, operators, limits) with a loader that initializes at function startup and supports environment-specific overrides.

stories.title: Standardize Enforcement Error Handling and Response Contract
stories.description: Define and implement consistent error responses for allowlist violations (e.g., unauthorized collection, invalid operator, limit exceeded) including HTTP status codes and audit-safe messages.

stories.title: Add Pre-Execution Query Sanitization Layer
stories.description: Implement sanitization to strip or reject disallowed query fields, nested operators, or injection patterns before allowlist validation executes.

stories.title: Validate Enforcement via End-to-End SIT Scenarios
stories.description: Extend SIT coverage to include adversarial and edge-case scenarios ensuring scope enforcement blocks all out-of-policy access while allowing valid queries.
